parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular cover made of stainless steel that fits on top of the kettle to retain heat and prevent spillage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the kettle, keeping the heat and steam inside while allowing easy removal for filling or cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an arched component made of heat-resistant plastic, attached to the side of the kettle for safe handling.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to hold and pour the kettle without direct contact with the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the kettle made of stainless steel, including the spout.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the water and conducts heat for boiling, with the spout allowing controlled pouring.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure that does not move but supports the lid and handle.
